rationales.novelty: The four incremental papers sharpen post-selection calibration, regulatory-boundary testing, projective registration, and runtime action rejection, but none independently identifies a frozen candidate's core treatment variable or overturns a stored functional collision. External candidate searches were not rerun, so no novelty upgrade is justified.
rationales.feasibility: Primary sources make several Gate 0 implementations more concrete, but decisive assets remain missing: natural communication failures, multiple product-level road tests, online depth-inclusive registration, complete closed-loop conformal calibration, persistent scene identity, and independent radar occupancy truth.
rationales.success-probability: The new evidence is more likely to produce useful boundaries or negative results than to validate the existing candidate mechanisms. Every stored candidate still fails at least one occurrence, identifiability, asset, or fair-comparison gate.
rationales.impact: The directions remain important because selection-aware certificates, real regulatory behavior, cooperative defer costs, trustworthy state alignment, and independent occupancy truth could materially change autonomous-driving evaluation and deployment practice even when experiments reject the proposed mechanisms.
rationales.comparison-readiness: The release adds strong adjacent comparators - post-selection conformal calibration, R79 boundary mapping, geometry-aware registration, and TTC shielding - but they have not been joined to the frozen candidate interventions in matched datasets, budgets, state forks, or closed-loop harnesses.

summary: All eight direction artifact sets, candidate pools, independent selection reports, dossiers, and stored rejection reviews were reopened. The four papers were treated strictly as local incremental evidence; external searches were not represented as rerun. No stored rejection is overturned, no exact-score panel passes, and the Idea center remains rejected with zero recommended candidates.
strongestObjection: Adjacent mechanisms are being made easier to name and prototype, but that is not evidence that their joint causal claims are identifiable. Promoting any current candidate would conflate local evidence accumulation with a complete novelty search and would turn certificate, geometry, or shield components into an unverified method combination.
requiredAction: Keep all candidates rejected. Any new cut derived from the four papers must restart the complete workflow: rerun external direct-competitor searches, freeze a new candidate pool and dossier, establish occurrence and asset gates, execute matched decisive experiments, and obtain a new independent exact-score panel. Priority evidence remains natural communication faults, cross-product road replication, closed-loop calibrated certificates, persistent scene identity, and independent radar occupied/free/unknown plus flow truth.

directionReportsReopened.finding: Both candidate pools, both selection reports, the legacy closure, and four rejected dossiers remain coherent. The platoon shield does not resolve natural ghost provenance, message age, temporal error dependence, or same-state cooperative marginal effects.

The 31-candidate pool and four rejected dossiers remain closed. Current accident-reasoning evidence confirms a perception-to-responsibility gap but supplies neither an online intervention nor an independently calibrated trigger for the rejected router, monitor, memory-leakage, or diagnosis candidates.

The 12-candidate pool and three rejected dossiers remain closed. DPA-I2P improves cross-modal pose registration but does not provide out-of-trajectory task truth, natural pose-geometry equivalence classes, or persistent current/stale/unknown state provenance.

Both security pools and four rejected dossiers remain closed. The new certificate and road-test papers improve safety-boundary evidence but do not create an executable attack path, trusted update lineage, unified recovery contract, or natural attack-to-MRM loop.

The 16-candidate pool and three rejected dossiers remain closed. Marginal certificates and one-VUT regulatory observations do not supply paired real/sim verdicts, natural version pairs, unselected-proposal truth, or cross-product replication.

The 13-candidate pool and three rejected dossiers remain closed. An external certificate around a fixed proposal bank does not isolate geolocation information, verifier winner's-curse effects, or caption-derived future-motion leakage inside end-to-end models.

The 15-candidate pool and three rejected dossiers remain closed. Candidate-specific future latents improve the planning interface, but non-expert counterfactual futures, nested candidate comparisons, and mechanism-valid causal repair remain unavailable.

The eight-candidate pool still has no shortlist. Real multi-observer localization evidence separates accuracy from availability value but does not provide independent voxel occupancy, free-space, teacher-error, or future-flow truth.

evidenceReopened.finding: The paper assumes vehicle information is acquired in time; its shield reduces collisions by converting some actions into 2.8%-8.3% abandonment, not by validating communication provenance or recovery under natural packet faults.
CAViAR provides 2,249 real accident videos and exposes a perception-reasoning gap, but it is retrospective single-view evidence and does not establish an online causal reasoning intervention.

DPA-I2P supports geometry-aware image-to-point-cloud alignment, while offline depth cost and the under-specified nuScenes protocol prevent it from supplying the task-level truth required by existing candidates.
The certificate covers the selected output of a frozen pipeline under marginal exchangeability; its closed-loop gate is explicitly uncalibrated, so it does not close the rejected security candidates.

The JRC study finds six potential R79 overshoots among 27 maneuvers, three significant after uncertainty, but one anonymous VUT and 1-second event annotation cannot support cross-product test inheritance.

OpenDriveVLA reports open-loop nuScenes planning and question-answering evidence; it does not provide the closed-loop interventions or independent treatment isolation required by the three rejected end-to-end candidates.
DA-WAM gives each candidate a distinct future latent, but observed-future supervision is available only for the expert-matched trajectory, leaving non-expert action consequences unverified.

The real Helsinki case study finds fusion dominated by connected-vehicle LiDAR with only limited radar gains; its endpoint is localization rather than independent occupied/free/unknown or occupancy-flow truth.
